Two new emails on the delivery step: Extra time and changes, which works out the overrun against the booked finish and prices it, and SSD return, which chases a loaned drive with the hire charge running. Three new add-ons ready to drop into a quote: extended storage, a connectivity survey, and mast and rigging.
